title: Asymptotic Mass Distribution of Random Holomorphic Sections
comment: 18 pages. v.2 Minor revisions. To appear in Anal. Math. Phys
abstract: In this note, we prove a central limit theorem for the mass distribution of random holomorphic sections associated with a sequence of positive line bundles endowed with $\mathscr{C}^3$ Hermitian metrics over a compact Kähler manifold. In addition, we show that almost every sequence of such random holomorphic sections exhibits quantum ergodicity in the sense of Zelditch.
